text: The case status stays rwb-case's. rwb-treatment reports a step outcome to the parent CaseWorkflow and the parent moves the status; no case table is read or written by this service, and the case status, the product, the treatment ID and the collateral facts reach the step on the forwarded case signal.
why: AC1 ends on the screen action and AC2 and AC3 end with the case in DECLINED_BY_CREDIT and WITH_FCR_OFFICER_SET of other slices, while Architecture v5 gives the case and its state to rwb-case, the connection matrix gives rwb-treatment no call to rwb-source-data, and DP-01 and DP-05 forbid reading another service's tables or an ACE view.
